title: Austronesian languages - Wikipedia
text: The Austronesian languages overall possess phoneme inventories which are smaller than the world average. Around 90% of the Austronesian languages have inventories of 19-25 sounds (15-20 consonants and 4-5 vowels), thus lying at the lower end of the global typical range of 20-37 sounds. text: Leipon is an endangered indigenous language of Papua New Guinea. It belongs to the Austronesian language family. The language is used as a first language by all adults in the ethnic community, but not all young people. It is not known to be taught in schools.
